construct: Spironolactone is a nonselective mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist that also antagonizes androgen signaling; its antiandrogen effects can cause gynecomastia and sexual adverse effects, whereas eplerenone is more selective.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A mineralocorticoid antagonist that improves hyperaldosteronism but causes gynecomastia/decreased libido is spironolactone; its nonselective antiandrogen action accounts for these adverse effects.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Spironolactone can alter androgen/estrogen balance through more than one endocrine effect, but among the listed receptor-level properties, androgen-receptor antagonism is the verified nonselective action that distinguishes it from more selective eplerenone and explains feminizing adverse effects.
